Specifically, your firm's rotating bottle sorter with individual air-blowing injectors was not routinely cleaned. Each automated air-blowing injector had an accumulation of dust near its surroundings. In addition, there was a comprehensive build-up of dust and filth inside the plexiglass cover which encapsulated both sides of the rotating OES bottle sorter and air- blowing injectors. There were no preventive maintenance and cleaning schedule of this air-blowing apparatus in order to control and minimize the potential for microbial contamination.
